description: This file defines an Android Activity class named ContactsListActivity that manages the display of a contacts list and contact details. It handles layout variations for different screen sizes, manages search intents, and communicates with fragments to update UI based on user interactions.

classes.name: ContactsListActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of contacts, handles search actions, and manages contact detail fragments for different screen sizes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, checks for search intents, and sets up the contact detail fragment if needed.

methods.name: onContactSelected
methods.description: Handles contact selection events; updates the detail fragment or starts a new activity based on layout configuration.

methods.name: onSelectionCleared
methods.description: Resets the contact detail fragment when no contact is selected.

methods.name: onSearchRequested
methods.description: Prevents multiple search requests if already showing search results, used on pre-HC Android versions.
